what_it_is.prose: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is India's largest IT services and consulting company and a flagship of the Tata Group. Its Aerospace & Defence (A&D) practice provides engineering services, digital transformation, cybersecurity, ERP/mission-readiness and product lifecycle management solutions to global A&D OEMs and to India's Ministry of Defence. TCS operates the Aerospace Design and Development Center in India jointly with Saab (covering military defense to civil security), and has expanded its engineering services footprint in India for Rolls-Royce (Civil Aerospace R&D). TCS's 'Future-Ready Skies Study 2025' tracks AI and eVTOL shifts in the aerospace sector. For India's MoD, TCS supports ERP for mission readiness — SAP-based logistics, inventory and procurement systems for the Indian Army, Navy and Air Force. TCS also partners with Ericsson for 5G-led defence communications and operates a cloud-based R&D environment for Ericsson (April 2021).
